_comment: The graphs inside cat-harness's `sdlc` sub-graph, declared FROM WITHIN (#980) on the pattern of `openapi/graph.json`: the `sdlc` entry of `cat-harness.json` names this directory, and this node names what it holds. Each entry is `subgraph: true` — a directory of the LAYER, listed by `resolveDirectories` with `within: "sdlc"`. Paths are relative to THIS directory. The sub-graph is OPT-IN (`optIn: true` on its entry): off in every layer, cat-harness's own included, unless that layer lists `cat-harness.sdlc` in its own `enableSubgraphs` (cat-harness#991 step 23.2; proposal §4.13, rulings Q12 and Q18 — named folders, a clean break, no redirects). Its processes and skills use the work plan, so a layer that enables `cat-harness.sdlc` enables `cat-harness.work-plan` too.
name: sdlc

directories.description: Software-delivery practice for agents and people working in the harness, as skill packages: `sdlc-core` (issues and PRs, review and merge, CI and gates, release, coordinating sessions and swarms), `crdm` (the requirements methodology) and `spec-kit`. Was the `sdlc` topic of `skills/` until cat-harness#991 step 23.2.

The executable software-delivery processes: branch, review, merge, gates, QA, publication, release and the bean lifecycle, with the DMN tables their gateways read in `decisions/`. Was the `sdlc` concern group of `processes/` until cat-harness#991 step 23.2; diagrams elsewhere call them by process id.
